d: A rundown of Zerodha's July 2026 updates across Kite and Varsity: including Kite Screener, revamped Stock SIPs, Trailing Stop-Loss on the Kite app, the leverage multiplier on the order window, simpler resident–NRI account conversions, Varsity Live sessions and Bootcamps, the new Delta newsletter, and The Back Office series.
